answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted vouching with a cool-down. New identities must lock a bond and wait several epochs before attestations count at full weight. During that wait, peers sample their work against a juniper of known-good fingerprints; mismatched phrasing or submit timing drops them. Once live, each endorsement still costs the endorser a pigment of slashable stake, so farms cannot buy cheap violet clones without burning capital on every copy. Honest agents vouch once and keep earning; attackers pay per fake forever.
